title: Kids Sport Fest
excerpt: ATTP Moldova takes part in Kids Sport Fest
body_html:
“Childhood is the heart of every age.”

Lucian Blaga

ATTP Moldova had the honour and great pleasure of taking part, through support and involvement, in the special Kids Sport Fest event for Children’s Day, organised this year by Sporter.md and partners such as Letz, Hipp, Gurinel TV and others!

As a reminder, 1 June 2024 at Arena Chișinău was a day full of fun and exciting sporting activities!
